Outcome labels show actual health damage, block gained, poison applied and capped healing.

The audio listener lookup uses the current Unity API.

Adapted campaign does not include every mechanic or content item from the original browser game.
Two inherited browser CI inventory failures remain documented and waived for this work.
Unattended Unity compilation still requires runner/licensing setup; Pages publication is automated for packaged builds.
Fixed-policy tests show faster Starseer runs and slower Herald runs; class balance still needs player feedback.
Existing sprite art is reused. Physical-device playback, audible sound review and full original-game parity remain outside this checkpoint.
